entries.original: Goals are now enabled by default, backed by dedicated storage, and track progress across active turns. (#23300, #23685, #23696, #23732)
entries.translated: `codex remote-control` CLI UX 개선

entries.translated: [codex] 외부 websocket 세션 초기화 제거

entries.original: Added clearer plugin-creator guidance for updating and reinstalling local personal plugins. (#23542)
entries.translated: [1/7] UserInput에 스레드 설정 추가

entries.translated: [2/7] UserInputWithTurnContext 제거
